notes: Implement compile-native IfElse (JUMP_IF_TRUE + predicates table) and Wrap (PUSH_FRAME/POP_FRAME + transforms table) in the compiled executor. This eliminates hybrid fallback for deterministic branching and wrapping stages, converting ~15-30% of compiled-hybrid plans to compiled-static. IfElse: boolean condition = dead-branch elimination at compile time, function condition = predicate table + jump. Wrap: prepare/finalize as transform table entries, WRAP frame for context save/restore. Expected impact: Cluster B benchmark moves from hybrid to static path. See compiled-executor-roadmap.md Phase 1.

Implement compile-native DoWhile (LOOP frame + reachEnd predicate + re-entry) and RetryOnError (RETRY frame + counter + backup/restore transforms). Requires PUSH_FRAME/POP_FRAME infra from TASK-011 and the explicit error-model contract from TASK-010 because RetryOnError semantics are boundary-sensitive. See compiled-executor-roadmap.md Phase 2.
